changelog: AI Chat now stores conversation sessions per user on the server, so each operator can reopen prior chats without mixing history with other users.
The floating chat widget can create a new chat, switch previous sessions and delete a chat history.
changelog_es: The AI chat now has per-user conversation sessions stored server-side, so each operator can return to previous chats without mixing history with other users.
Users can create a new chat, switch previous sessions and delete a chat history from the floating chat widget.
